why: The hour moves forward with nothing going in circles. The orchestrating session (97f1184b) took the 391 spec and plan and the 390 plan delta through review in two rounds each, fixing each finding once with nothing undone, and handed the 25 Complete Servant rows back to gm-assistant, who confirmed every finding. what: Go on as planned: run the step-back, then the ten first source-reader reads of 0251's cited sources (one bundle per source, WAVE_OK per prompt as the headless rules require), then hand off to the check session.
tooling_fix: In the round-cap counting behind the pair/round guard, count a source-reader dispatch on a check-bundle key with no earlier verdict as round 1 for that key, not as another round on the question, so a first read of many new sources never reaches the cap; add a test with ten first-read dispatches on one question that stays under the cap.
